5ae9f4a030a1.en: Construction companies trust I-Cost with their estimates, supplier quotes, orders and people. Here is how we protect that data, what we follow, and how to report a security problem.

1972b7a4f394.en: <1>Cyber Essentials certified.</1> In November 2026 I-COST LTD passed Cyber Essentials, the UK government-backed scheme run with the National Cyber Security Centre, first time and with every answer marked compliant. It covers firewalls, secure settings, security updates within 14 days, user access with two-step login and malware protection across our laptops, phones, servers and cloud services. <2>Check our certificate</2>.

5c751cdff566.en: We are aligning our information security with <1>ISO/IEC 27001:2022</1>: our policies, risk register and Statement of Applicability (all 93 Annex A controls) follow its structure. We are <2>not certified</2>. Read <3>our security policies in brief</3>; the full documents are available to customers on request: <4>info@i-cost.co.uk</4>.

3d9f9a3ec4b1.en: Every request is checked so a company can only reach its own projects, prices, documents and people. An automated test checks this for every page before each update goes live.

17b753a41d3e.en: Your company admin decides what each role, and each person, can see and do, and which projects each person works on.

19cd3fd299fb.en: Orders, invoices, delivery notes, certificates, timesheet photos and drawings are checked when uploaded, kept in private storage and opened only by people signed in to your company.

5880bc377f39.en: Our team looks at customer data only when needed to support you or keep the service running.

ae6b1686b175.en: Company admins can download all their company's data as a zip whenever they want.

68adc1453d21.en: The companies that process data for us are listed, with where and why, on our <1>subprocessors page</1>.

c9b1f334fac9.en: A stolen password is not enough.

37b37bf8b3fb.en: At least 12 characters, stored only as one-way hashes. Sign-in pauses after 5 wrong passwords.

2236c9a20f6f.en: A code from a free authenticator app, or by email, as well as the password, with backup codes for a lost phone.

432b8a09d81d.en: Admins see every sign-in and every change to people, permissions and settings: when, who and from where. Nobody can edit it.

08a5c1fbf156.en: HTTPS only. Sign-in cookies are never sent with forms from other websites, and I-Cost pages cannot be framed by other sites.

47b882c40552.en: In the UK, copied every hour.

034dc251aaca.en: The application, database and files are hosted in the United Kingdom (Manchester), with a standby server in London.

79bd1718277e.en: The database and new or changed files are copied off the server every hour to Cloudflare R2, encrypted at rest. Each company's records are also backed up daily.

c4e25016594d.en: The London standby refreshes itself every night and can take over in about an hour. At most one hour of data could be lost.

709cf086ef14.en: Every change runs our full automated test suite, including security checks, on the same software versions as the live service.

d3d4ba5f0c25.en: Supported versions of Laravel and PHP. We follow NCSC alerts and patch critical issues within a day.

7945c4d62129.en: A written incident plan. If a breach affects your data we tell you without undue delay, and report to the ICO within 72 hours where the law requires.

a4c00f183e63.en: Statement of Applicability (ISO/IEC 27001 Annex A)<1>On request</1>

b579cbf29648.en: To ask for a document, or for help with a security questionnaire, email <1>info@i-cost.co.uk</1>.

a100ae1b145a.en: Email <1>info@i-cost.co.uk</1> with "Security" in the subject and enough detail for us to reproduce it. We acknowledge reports within 3 working days and keep you updated.

394076203a41.en: Please only test against your own account, do not access, change or delete other people's data, avoid anything that slows the service down, and give us reasonable time to fix the issue before telling anyone else. We will not take legal action against good-faith research that follows these rules.
